summary: Implemented deterministic project-guide frontier reconciliation in the fast allocator. STATE.frontier_refs are now classified as executable, active, capability_requirement, terminal, or missing; only executable+active satisfy the generic project frontier minimum. This prevents terminal VERIFIED/DONE refs from keeping a frontier falsely full and keeps specialized browser/publication work visible as capability requirements instead of counting it as generic executable work. The Prometeo Live revision-1 fixture resolves to terminal=1, capability_requirement=2, effective=0; an ordinary two-job executable/active fixture remains effective=2. A later main descendant containing this change passed Prometeo Live Feed CI with PROJECT_GUIDE_EFFECTIVE_FRONTIER_PASS.
